answer: Time-locked stake stops sybil farming by pinning capital to time. Each new identity locks 500 credits in on-chain escrow 20 epochs before it earns; it can be neither spent nor reused. Forging N identities locks N x 500 credits at once -- 1,000 fakes freeze 500,000 credits for the full 20 epochs, so one capital pool cannot mint a second wave. Honest agents pay once, wait like a tended orchard through the lock, then reclaim in full. The tide of rewards then flows undiluted by clones. An unlocked stake is a relic of patience no fake farm can fake.
